MOORLAND WITH STONE CIRCLES AND SHEEP WALLS: a rolling purple-brown moor covered in low heath, a stone circle of eight standing stones on the highest ridge, dry-stone sheep walls dividing the moor into rough pens, a lone shepherd's bothy of grey stone beside a peat stream
